title: 第11章 只能靠自己第12章 穷困潦倒
slug: 本掌门负债成仙第158章陷阱
content_zh:
冷魔艳把庞思月带到了灵船下，围在内层法阵外的债主正等着挑选想交换的东西，就看到了她拖着的纯阴体。
顿时，大家都没看清楚脸就纷纷喊道：“这个我要了，我出高价。”
“纯阴体？我们门派用债务交换了。”
“你们怎么能这样丧心病狂，这可是活生生的人，又不是物件，我愿意与这位道友结为道侣。”
“我和月极宫有交情，可以推荐道友去月极宫拜师。”
“那不如来跟着姐姐我学天地阴阳大调和，斩杀一切好色之徒，修为可一日千里。”
“呃，你这个一日千里它伤身吗？”
“你来试试就知道了。”
“不敢不敢。”
庞思月从来没离开过北斗宗自己家的峰头，哪见过这么多对着他品头论足，一点也不客气的修士，赶快用袖袍挡住了脸。
冷魔艳只是冷冷地说道：“这是男的，庞老祖的儿子。”
“……”众修士全部往后退了两步，不是因为他是纯阴男体，而是因为他爹是庞老祖。
这里也就有三位结丹修士，看到庞老祖都只能恭恭敬敬行礼，被骂也只敢默默走一边，在心里咒骂脸上都不敢表露出来，更别说其它的筑基和炼气修士了。
他的儿子再废物，再是个没有修为的纯阴男体，那也不敢招惹。
再说了，只要破掉纯阴体，人家修炼起来那修为如同飞一样快，你现在得罪他，改天就打上门来揍你了。
“原来是庞公子，失敬失敬。”
“庞公子是否有受到惊吓，我这里有一瓶静心丸，能安心静神。”
“早闻庞公子乃天资俊才，今日一见果然有庞老祖的风采。”
“不知庞公子可有婚配？我家族中有十几位适龄的侄女，虽无灵根，但极为貌美，愿为庞公子端茶倒水做个侍妾。”
“庞公子，我们送你回北斗宗吧，外面妖兽众多，相当的危险。”

“马屁精。”不知谁在人群里骂了一句，引得修士相互怒目。
谁啊！
你清高，你了不起，有本事就站出来。
“各位前辈不要围着了，瓜田李下的，庞公子有个什么事，北斗宗可不会放过大家。”冷魔艳在一旁劝道。
“庞老祖又被我家师叔祖打伤而逃，虽然不至于就这么死了，但肯定会记恨在心。”
她仰头瞧着四周的修士，“我们守灵门又不怕他，他无处发泄，寻个由头找你们门派的麻烦，那可就不好了。”
“不如趁庞老祖受了伤，把他的儿子吊起来，布下重重陷阱，引诱他过来救子，大家再一拥而上。”冷魔艳伸手在脖子做了个抹脖子的动作，阴险地说道。
众修士惊诧地看着她，心中便是一惊，此女好狠毒。
这守灵门可真是了不得，灵归真人都收了些什么歪瓜烂梨，小小年纪心思就如此大胆狠毒。
那可是元婴老祖，她嘴一张就要布下陷阱弄死对方。
万万不可以再打这个庞老祖儿子的主意，出了事都脱不了关系。
“各位道友，要一起吗？”冷魔艳目光扫过众人，童声童语地问道。
众人直接散开了，重新去看地上那些灵船残渣，认真又专注地寻找感兴趣的东西。
什么庞老祖的儿子，清方州的人和他们宁梨州有何关系，谁想搭理谁去。
冷魔艳看没人愿意接这个屎盆子，就把一直用衣袍掩面的庞思月给带走了。
她看了看被法阵圈住的外层，到处是树木、石头、杂草，其它什么也没有。
于是把人带到了右边的崖壁前，找到条石缝，她钻进去拿出小刀用灵力把石头挖下来，把石缝里扩大到了一丈左右大小。
她掏出朱砂，在石缝上方写了两个大字：庞府。
“好了，这里就是你的住所。只要不走出外面的法阵，就没有任何危险。妖兽进不来，阵内也禁止修士斗法，你就在这里好好养伤吧。”冷魔艳说道，然后便转身要离开。
庞思月急忙喊住她，“你就把我扔在这里？”
content_en:
Leng Moyan took Pang Siyue under the spirit boat. The creditors gathered outside the inner circle were waiting to choose what they wanted to exchange, and they saw the pure yin body she was dragging.
Suddenly, everyone shouted without even seeing their faces: "I want this, and I'll pay a high price."
"Pure Yin body? Our sect used debt in exchange for it."
"How can you be so heartless? This is a living person, not an object. I am willing to become a Taoist companion with this fellow Taoist."
"I have a relationship with Yueji Palace. I can recommend Taoist friends to go to Yueji Palace to become a disciple."
"Then why don't you come and follow me, sister, to learn the great harmony of yin and yang between heaven and earth, kill all the lecherous people, and your cultivation will improve rapidly."
"Uh, is it hurting your health if you are traveling so fast?"
"You'll know after you try it."
"Don't dare."
Pang Siyue had never left the peak of his home in the Beidou Sect. He had never seen so many monks criticizing him and not being polite at all. He quickly covered his face with his sleeves and robes.
Leng Moyan just said coldly: "This is a man, the son of Patriarch Pang."
"..." All the monks took two steps back, not because he had a pure yin male body, but because his father was Patriarch Pang.
There are also three pill-building monks here. They can only salute respectfully when they see Patriarch Pang. They dare to walk aside silently when they are scolded. They curse in their hearts and dare not show it on their faces, let alone the other foundation-building and Qi-refining monks.
No matter how useless his son is, no matter how pure a yin male body he is without cultivation, he would not dare to offend him.
Besides, as long as the pure Yin body is broken, the person's cultivation will be as fast as flying. If you offend him now, he will come to beat you another day.
"It turns out to be Mr. Pang, disrespectful and disrespectful."
"Mr. Pang, are you frightened? I have a bottle of Jingxin Pills here to calm your mind."
"I have long heard that Mr. Pang is a talented man. Today, when I saw him, he really looked like Ancestor Pang."
"I wonder if Mr. Pang is getting married? There are more than a dozen nieces of the right age in my family. Although they have no spiritual roots, they are extremely beautiful. They are willing to serve Mr. Pang tea and serve as concubines."
"Mr. Pang, let's take you back to the Beidou Sect. There are many monsters outside and it's quite dangerous."
"Flatterer." Someone in the crowd cursed, causing the monks to glare at each other.
Who!
You are noble, you are great, stand up if you have the ability.
"Seniors, please stop standing around. If Mr. Pang has something to do, the Beidou Sect will not let you go." Leng Moyan advised from the side.
"Old Ancestor Pang was wounded by my great-uncle again and fled. Although he won't die like that, he will definitely hold a grudge in his heart."
She raised her head and looked at the monks around her, "We, the guardian sect, are not afraid of him. He has nowhere to vent. If he finds an excuse to cause trouble for your sect, that would be bad."
"It's better to take advantage of Patriarch Pang's injury, hang his son up, lay many traps, lure him to come to save the son, and then everyone swarms up." Leng Moyan stretched out her hand and wiped his neck, saying sinisterly.
The monks looked at her in surprise, and were shocked in their hearts. This woman was so vicious.
This guarding gate is really amazing. What kind of evil things have been accepted by Master Linggui? He is so bold and vicious at such a young age.
That was the ancestor of Nascent Soul, and she would lay a trap to kill the other party with just her mouth.
You must not take advantage of this Patriarch Pang's son again, he will not be able to get rid of it if anything happens.
"Fellow Taoists, do you want to come together?" Leng Moyan glanced at everyone and asked in a childlike voice.
Everyone immediately dispersed and looked at the remnants of the spirit ship on the ground again, looking for anything of interest seriously and intently.
What does Patriarch Pang's son have to do with the people of Qing Fang Prefecture and their Ningli Prefecture? Whoever wants to talk to him can do it.
Leng Moyan saw that no one was willing to accept this shit, so she took Pang Siyue away, who had been hiding her face in her robe.
She looked at the outer layer surrounded by the magic circle. There were trees, stones, weeds everywhere, and nothing else..
So she took the person to the cliff on the right and found a crack in the stone. She got in and took out a knife to dig out the stone with her spiritual power, expanding the crack to about one foot in size.
She took out the cinnabar and wrote two big characters on the crack of the stone: Pang Mansion.
"Okay, this is your residence. As long as you don't step out of the magic circle outside, there is no danger. Monsters can't come in, and monks are prohibited from fighting in the magic circle. You can just recuperate here." Leng Moyan said, and then turned to leave.
Pang Siyue hurriedly called to her, "You're just going to leave me here?"
